text:
The `item-read` proposal passes: `text-check` printed no flags, and I logged one "clear" line in `flags.jsonl`.

It's an agent brief rather than an owner page, so the owner-facing checks (screenshots, ticked asks) don't apply. Its title says what it does, the "Why" section explains the problem in plain sentences, and the build steps, fences and "Done means" are short and numbered. I made no rewrites.

I rewrote the item-read task's outcome, and `node Server/text-check.mjs` now flags nothing on it. I didn't open any page, so the screenshot check is skipped. This task changed code, with no page of its own.

The old outcome was 159 words, over the 120 limit. It also didn't tick each ask. The new one is about 97 words, with each ask ticked and its proof beside it:
- **Read a dotted path:** `item({path, read:"a.b.c"})` answers without writing. Proof: 27 checks in `Servex/agents/item-read.test.mjs`.
- **Refuse read-only verbs as deltas:** get, find, toJSON and the rest are refused and the caller is pointed at `read`. Proof: the same test, at top level and nested.
- **Build the page's own class:** a `page.jsonl` replays as the class its line 1 names, such as LivePage.js, and falls back to Page if that module is broken. Proof: the real `/live/LivePage.js` replayed in the test.

It also says the five older tests still pass and that a Servex restart is needed.

Nobody owns the task any more, so I appended the new outcome to the task's `session.jsonl` myself. The rewrite is logged in `flags.jsonl`.
